issue.body:
Hello all :)

I want to make a middleware that redirect to the login page if the request has no session (with the session middleware).

So I do this:

```python
class AuthMiddleware(BaseHTTPMiddleware):
    async def __call__(self, scope, receive, send):

        request = Request(scope, receive=receive)

        return templates.TemplateResponse("login.html", {
            "request": request,
            "errormsg": "You had to login to continue"
        })

```

But I got this error: 
```
<path_to_venv>/starlette/requests.py", line 136, in url_for
    router = self.scope["router"]
KeyError: 'router'
```

So what I need to do to make the `url_for` working from here ?
issue.title: Return a TemplateResponse  with an `url_for` from middleware
